Chapter 802: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters Combined)_2

Chapter 802: Chapter 17: Astonishing Harvest (Eight Thousand Words, Two Chapters Combined)_2

Once inside the World, Lin Yuan had full control over its World Consciousness at his whim.

If he didn’t intend to stir up too much commotion and planned to subtly replace the World Will, it would have taken some time. The worlds Lin Yuan now governs would likely exceed thirty-two worlds by several times.

“Including the beings of Tianqing World, the inhabitants of thirty-three worlds are all following the Martial Dao Cultivation Evolution Path…”

Lin Yuan slowly closed his eyes; as the founder and opener, he could sense whenever a Martial Dao Cultivator emerged.

At this moment, in the Boundless Void where Martial Dao Cultivators represented, a region of luminescence had already formed.

“Perhaps, the Martial Dao Cultivators that I’ve shaped will change the circumstances in the Boundless Void, breaking the monopoly of the Foreign Evil God?”

...

Lin Yuan silently pondered.

Before Lin Yuan’s arrival, the Foreign Evil God was the absolute ruler of this Boundless Void, as for human cultivators? They were merely ‘appetizers’ within numerous worlds.

The Foreign Evil God feasted on worlds, and the human cultivators living within those worlds only served to make this food taste better, used by the Evil God as an appetizer.

Even the World’s Children and Children of Destiny born from the world itself have only a slight ability to resist the Evil God, depending entirely on the world itself.

However, the Martial Tao Cultivation System has given the beings of this world the possibility to resist the Foreign Evil God.

Of course, this possibility is still invisible. Currently, within the Boundless Void, the strongest among the Martial Dao Cultivators has only reached the Martial Tao Fifth Stage.

“The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule reaching the Sixth Realm is indeed difficult.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts shifted, and he slightly shook his head.

Three hundred years ago, Lin Yuan stepped into the Third Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules.

Two hundred and eighty years ago, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules reached the Fourth Realm.

Two hundred years ago, the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule ascended to the Fifth Realm.

Over the subsequent two hundred years, Lin Yuan’s Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule remained at the Fifth Realm.

The Sixth Realm? At least for now, Lin Yuan saw no hope.

Over a hundred years, advancing from the Dual Realm to the Fifth Realm of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, aside from Lin Yuan’s own Against-Heaven’s Understanding, the comprehension from the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses about the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules was also a great help.

Understand that even for those unique special lives in the Main Universe, advancing one realm in the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules could take eons: billions, tens of billions of years.

That is under smooth conditions, with slight bottlenecks, the time consumption would be endless.

“Just take it slowly.”

“How much time has passed now?”

Lin Yuan slightly shook his head; the comprehension of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules at the Fifth Realm from that group of Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses was no longer of much help to him.

Because the limit within that comprehension luminance was the Fifth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules.

Regarding ascending into the Sixth Realm, it had to rely entirely on Lin Yuan himself.

Normally, the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules is the domain of a Supreme Being.

“Fortunately, among the rewards on the fifth layer of the Black Tower, I chose the Secret Skill ‘Milky Way,’ which allowed me to see the direction of the Sixth Realm.”

“Otherwise, to comprehend the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules below a Supreme Being, who knows how long it would take.”

Memories of the Secret Skill “Milky Way” floated through Lin Yuan’s mind.

Why is the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules exclusive to Supreme Beings?

It’s because it involves the mysteries above the River of Time; only Supreme Beings can detach from the River of Time to hypothesize the various scenes on the ‘shore’ of that river.

This is the foundation for stepping into the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules.

But Lin Yuan? Still belongs to the Long River Inner Life, without any condition to observe the ‘shore’ of the River of Time, even though the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization forcefully brought Lin Yuan to the shore.

Due to his own life level, the scenes he observed were extremely narrow, holding little significance.

However, the Secret Skill “Milky Way,” illustrates the mysteries of the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules in another form.

Allowing Lin Yuan to comprehend the further mysteries and essence of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules without having to ‘go ashore.’

Of course, even so, comprehending the Sixth Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules is not an easy task; it requires Lin Yuan to explore slowly.

After all, the path he is taking now, no life from the inception of the Main Universe Cosmic Epoch has ever treaded.

“The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Fifth Realm, my current strongest combat power, should be comparable to a Tier 11 Fifth Tier powerhouse, right?”

Lin Yuan assessed himself.

The Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule at the Fifth Realm marks the threshold of the Fifth Layer Tier 11.

Currently, aside from his life level still being at Tenth Rank, Lin Yuan is not weaker in other aspects compared to an Eleventh-Rank life.

Furthermore, by relying on the Fifth Physical Body Divine Ability ‘World,’ he can completely overpower a Tier 11 Fifth Tier powerhouse.

The external world formed by Divine Ability ‘World,’ once self-destructed, not even a Tier 11 Perfection can withstand it. However, this move is the strongest trump card, which Lin Yuan will not use unless absolutely necessary.

Merely through the natural suppression by the external world, even a Tier 11 Fifth Tier will feel exceedingly uncomfortable.

“These three hundred years, the harvest has been astonishing.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, three hundred years ago, before undergoing his tenth traversal, Lin Yuan’s strongest combat power was merely limited to Eleventh Rank Fourth Layer.

But now, in a normal state, he could suppress the Fifth Layer, and if he uses his trump card, even a Tier 11 Perfection would perish.

And this, is merely over the past three hundred years.

Moreover, this magnitude of enhancement in strength is based on Lin Yuan still being a Tenth Rank life, the difficulty is countless times more than from enhancing from Eleventh Rank Fourth Layer to Eleventh Rank Sixth Layer.
